name: Mahjongg by MawJayne
description: Eastern North Carolina mahjong community that sells table time at Beaufort Marketplace on Highway 264 in Washington. Its own pages say NMJL playing cards are provided on site, and assisted guided play is available by reservation. Drop-in seats are $10, no membership needed.
schedule: Table time in the morning, afternoon and evening on booking days (dates listed on the club site)
